output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The '_transfer' function has an integer overflow that allows users to cause a denial of service (balance can be made negative).
The 'transferFrom' function allows users to transfer tokens from other users, if they have an allowance set.
The 'approve' function uses predictable values, allowing attackers to forge token transactions.
